name: azure-log-analytics-kql-app
description: Secure Node.js app for querying Azure Log Analytics and turning KQL filters into GUI controls.

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace azure-kql-app-server" "npm run dev --workspace azure-kql-app-client" "npm run check-health"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace azure-kql-app-server && npm run build --workspace azure-kql-app-client
scripts.test: npm test --workspace azure-kql-app-server && npm test --workspace azure-kql-app-client
scripts.prod: npm run build && npm run start:prod
scripts.production: npm run build && npm run start:prod
